newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Westchester County, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Westchester County, N.Y..

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the undersigned Commissioner of Finance of the County of Westchester, New York (the

chaclian Office Building, 148 Martine Avenue, Room 720, White Plains, New York 10601 on until 11:00 a.m. (EST) at which time they will be opened publicly and announced for the purchase of $59,505,000 of General Obligation Serial Bonds-1996 (the Bonds'') of the County, due as follows:

The Bonds will be dated October 31, 1996, and will bear interest at the rates per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor in accordance herewith, payable on May 15, 1997 and November 15, 1997 and semi-annually thereafter on May 15 and November 15 in each year until maturity.
The Bonds maturing on or after November 15, 2007 will be subject to redemption prior to maturity at the option of the County on November 15, 2006 and thereafter, as a whole or in part.

As a condition precedent to the consideration of its proposal, each bidder is required to deposit with the Sale Officer a certified or cashier's check drawn upon an incorporated bank or trust company and payable to the order of the County of Westchester, New York in the amount of $1,190,100 and such check should be enclosed with the proposal.
The County reserves the right to reject all bids. Any bid which fails to substantially comply with the terms of this notice will be rejected.

The successful bidder will be furnished without cost with the approving opinions of the law firms of Whitman Breed Abbott & Morgan and Plunkett & Jaffe, P.C., Co-Bond Counsel, to the effect that the Bonds are valid and legally binding general obligations of the County of Westchester.

The Official Statement accompanying this Notice of Sale is in a form deemed final'' by the County for the purpose of Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 15c2-12 but is subject to modification or supplement.

A Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained from the Office of the Commissioner of Finance of the County of Westchester, in White Plains, New York, at (914) 285-2756, the offices of Whitman Breed Abbott & Morgan, New York, New
York, at (212) 351-3236, or the offices of Plunkett & J P.C., White Plains, New York, at (914) 948-7722.
